name: Instruments column: bare anchor clone
why: _buildInstrumentVocalsListItem() copies the instrument link alone again: the copy keeps the stamp and loses the icon.
grep: a decorated instrument keeps its icon

name: helper does not copy the icon
why: _cloneInstrumentAnchorWithIcon() returns the anchor without its icon.
grep: a decorated instrument keeps its icon

name: credit annotation: bare anchor clone
why: _buildCreditListItem() copies a credited instrument link alone again.

name: instrument-list Name: bare anchor clone
why: Name_Comment_Description copies the Name link alone again.

name: icon-less copy keeps the stamp (alone)
why: _cloneInstrumentAnchorWithIcon() no longer removes the stamp from an icon-less copy. _iiReleaseIconlessAnchors() removes it after the render anyway, so the late icon still arrives: the two cover for each other.

name: no post-render sweep (alone)
why: _iiReleaseIconlessAnchors() does nothing. Every copy site on the tested pages goes through the helper, which already removes the stamp: the two cover for each other.

name: stamp kept AND no sweep
why: Both ways of handing an icon-less copy back to the script are gone: it stays stamped, and a late icon never reaches the column.

name: reconciler never installed
why: _iiInstallIconReconciler() returns at once: a late icon stays on the live clone and the next re-render loses it.

name: late icon not mirrored onto the source row
why: _iiMirrorLateIcons() resolves the source anchor but does not copy the icon onto it.

name: uniq cache not dropped on a late icon
why: A late icon changes no visible row, so the 📊 scan cached before it is replayed: the bass entry never shows its icon.

name: filter-result cache not dropped on a late icon
why: runFilter() replays the cached "without instrument icon" row list from before the icon arrived.

name: active icon filter not re-run on a late icon
why: The caches are dropped but the table on screen keeps the rows filtered against the old icons.

name: icon modes swapped
why: _cellMatchesStructureMode() answers ii-icon-yes with the ii-icon-no test and vice versa.
grep: ticking an entry leaves exactly those rows

name: "with instrument icon" never counted
why: The scan never increments iiIconYesCount.

name: matched links not highlighted
why: _highlightInstrumentIconMatch() marks nothing.
grep: ticking an entry leaves exactly those rows

name: value entries without icon
why: renderItems() no longer appends the cell's icon to a plain value entry.

name: "» instrument:" entries without icon
why: makeValueSynItem() no longer appends the instrument's icon.

name: "» instrument:" entries without icon (mobile)
why: Same plant, seen through a tap on chromium-mobile.

name: section offered without the script
why: The scan no longer asks _iiPresent(): a page without the script gets an "Instrument info - Icon" section counting every row as icon-less.

name: no post-render re-check on a fetched page
why: _iiInstallIconReconciler() gives up when nothing is stamped at render time: on a fetched page (search) a 📊 opened before the script stamped the rows keeps its cached scan, and the "Instrument info - Icon" section never appears.
